Author: Anomaly
Name: Pet Service
Description: A private FFXIV tool for consensual pet/master roleplay and power dynamics. Masters manage messages and reminders through Discord, the website, or the in-game Master page. Pets receive interactive prompts with replies, snoozing, shared status and location, and a local kill switch.
Punchline: Consensual pet/master roleplay, messages, and shared routines.
Changelog:
- Separate Pet and password-protected Master pages with the website controls in game.
- /petservice call and Call master buttons share the attention-request cooldown.
- Fixed, normal-sized prompts without a full-screen backdrop or close button.
- Improved native chat typing and a Use game chat button.
- Custom reply buttons with optional written replies.
- Cleaner Discord notifications without delivery timestamps or event IDs.
- Retain housing addresses, custom snoozing, and the confirmed local kill switch.
